projects.name: PatientPathly - Clinic Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive clinic management software. Implemented database connections, user tables, and integrated backend endpoints for managing clinic operations seamlessly.

projects.name: Medical & Orthopedic Store POS
projects.description: Designed and developed a multi-module store management platform handling inventory, batch management, expiry tracking (FEFO), purchases, and sales. Engineered to support 3,000+ products with PDF invoice generation.
projects.techstack: Flutter Web, Firebase, Riverpod, Clean Architecture

projects.name: Job Seeker Platform Backend
projects.description: Designed a scalable backend for a Job Seeker web application. Built schemas for Job, User, and Application models. Implemented advanced JWT authentication, authorization, role-based access, and resume file uploads.

projects.name: Medicine Reminder Offline App
projects.description: Developed a production-ready offline-first medication management app. Engineered an intelligent scheduling system supporting custom reminder times, missed-dose tracking, and calendar-based history with zero internet dependency.
projects.techstack: Flutter, Riverpod, Isar Database, Material Design 3

projects.name: COVID-19 Live Tracker
projects.description: Built a data-driven mobile application that displays live COVID-19 statistics (cases, recoveries, deaths) globally. Integrated public REST APIs for real-time updates and data visualization.
projects.techstack: Flutter, Provider, REST API, Clean Architecture

projects.name: Real-Time Weather App
projects.description: Developed a dynamic weather forecasting application. Implemented location-based weather fetching, 7-day forecasts, and dynamic UI themes based on current weather conditions.

projects.name: IQ POS - Point of Sale System
projects.description: A robust Point of Sale (POS) application designed for seamless retail and checkout management. Features include real-time inventory tracking, daily sales reporting, secure payment flows, and digital invoice generation.
